definition: ἀπο-γραφή, -ῆς, ἡ (ἀπογράφω)  [in LXX: Dan.10:21 (כָּתָב), I Est.8:30, AB, 2Ma.2:1, 3Ma.2:32 3Mac 4:15 3Mac 4:17 3Mac 7:22 * ;] __1. a written copy.  __2. As law term, a deposition (Demos.).  __3. In late writers, a register, enrolment, census (MM, see word; Deiss., LAE, 160, 268 f.): Luk.2:2, Act.5:37.† (AS)
